Persistent Impact Score lag curves. Global lifts were flat and non-decaying (DRIVE/SPOT_UP/TRANSITION horizon=5; others 0). SPOT_UP lag-1 lift +0.027 (ctrl_p=0.0000). Extended Possession Value (direct PPP plus opponent T+1 suppression). 4 of 8 play types showed real downstream opponent next-PPP components: CUT +0.0220 suppression, TRANSITION +0.0145, SPOT_UP +0.0124, POST_UP +0.0194. Net-swing play-type scoring prototype (52 series / 104 units). Top recommendation changed in 40/104 (38%) of units when scoring by net swing rather than own PPP. Verdict: descriptive. Not evaluated against outcomes; uses in-series observed opponent next PPP. Sample/power NOT_RECORDED.

Persistent Impact Score Level 1 gate (915,570 possessions; n>150k per lag). Decay-sanity FAILED: DRIVE lifts +0.015, +0.020, +0.018, +0.021, +0.020 (flat, not decaying). Within-team DRIVE lag-1 +0.015 to -0.002. Cohen d ~0.01-0.03. Callable play-type horizons = 0. Team-quality confound. Verdict: failed_gate.

Play-type labeling audit (50,668 possessions). OTHER: 36% end in fouls, PPP inflated (FOUL_BUCKET). DRIVE: 12 pp below foul benchmark (FOUL_LEAK). PNR: 22% foul rate. Only 335 of 50,668 possessions (0.7%) map to a real play type via initiation_type. Verdict: artifact_found.

Sequential pair premium and defensive aftershock (8/8 PTs). historical_effect.explanation: The retrieved records show that raw lag and cross-possession lifts are mostly artifacts after team-season demeaning (SF-APPS-073, SF-CHT-029), that the play-type labels have a documented leakage problem (SF-CHT-025), and that the downstream opponent effects are small (SF-APPS-075) and not durable (SF-APPS-049). Together these move the decision from a direct test of AVOID to a proceed-with-changes design that first fixes the AVOID threshold and label validity and then tests the opponent next-PPP claim with demeaning, placebo and multiplicity control.

blocking_constraints.text: AVOID is defined from the same outcome (opponent next PPP); the threshold must be fixed before analysis or the label is circular.
Team quality, team-season effects and score context confound opponent next-PPP after play X; the retrieved artifacts were driven by this.
Play-type labels have a documented leakage problem (initiation_type maps only 0.7% of possessions; foul-ending inflation) that must be corrected before attributing outcomes to play X.
Per-play-type effects of about 0.01 to 0.02 PPP need large cells; per-player and per-lineup AVOID labels are likely underpowered.
Testing many play types, lags and players without correction inflated apparent effects in earlier families.

prior_work.summary: Related work covers opponent next-PPP effects by play type (SF-APPS-075: small downstream effects of about 0.01 to 0.02 PPP for 4 of 8 play types; DRIVE not real), durable net-swing branches (SF-APPS-049: none durable, rejected), and own-sequence lag memory (SF-APPS-073 and SF-CHT-029: artifacts after demeaning, with SPOT_UP lag-1 the only small exception). The records do not test the AVOID claim against a defined threshold, so the question is only partly answered.

risks.text: AVOID labels defined from opponent next PPP are circular with the outcome they are meant to explain; an explicit, pre-set threshold and a separate outcome window are needed.
Team quality and team-season effects produced flat, non-decaying lifts (SF-CHT-029, SF-APPS-073); demeaning and matched baselines are required.
initiation_type maps 0.7% of possessions and foul endings inflate OTHER PPP (SF-CHT-025); foul-ending possessions must be excluded or modelled.
Per-play-type effects of about 0.01 to 0.02 PPP require large cells; player and lineup cells with n of 30 to 95 (SF-APPA-050, SF30) are underpowered.
Many play types, lags and players were tested with no correction in SF-APPA-050; BH correction was applied to player-level results in SF-APPS-075 only.
Placebo ranges in SF30 contained the real effect, and SF-CHT-009 had no placebo; any AVOID claim needs a placebo that is shown to be informative.
Signs flipped across quarters and between regular season and playoffs (SF30); playoff and regular-season effects must be tested separately.
Sparse opponent-play by star cells (min n_after=30) make per-star AVOID labels unstable.
Net-swing rankings changed the top recommendation in 38% of units (SF-APPM-011) without outcome validation, so the measure's reliability is not established.

design.estimand: Within-team, team-season-demeaned difference in opponent next-possession PPP after the opponent runs play type X, relative to a matched baseline of the same team's possessions, with the AVOID threshold fixed in advance.
design.unit: Possession (opponent play X followed by the next possession of the same opponent team), grouped by team-season.
design.sample: Regular season 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and playoffs 2022-23 to 2024-25 (complete); 2025-26 regular season only through 2026-04-13 (complete). Exclude 2025-26 playoffs (complete only from 2026-06-21, after the 2026-06-19 question date) and any partial 2025-26 data.
design.power: Compute minimum detectable effect per play type before analysis; the recorded effects of about 0.01 to 0.02 PPP require large cells (order 10^4 to 10^5 possessions). Per-player and per-lineup AVOID labels are not expected to reach adequate power and should be reported descriptively only.
design.controls: Team-season fixed effects; opponent quality; score margin and garbage-time exclusion; period; lineup; pace. Foul-ending possessions excluded or modelled; play-type labels validated against the possession graph before use (not initiation_type alone).
design.falsification: Placebo play types and shuffled opponent assignments; lag-2 and lag-3 checks for decay; repeat within regular season and playoffs separately to detect sign flips. A pre-set placebo range must contain the real estimate for a null to be claimed.
design.multiplicity: Holm or Benjamini-Hochberg correction across play types, lags and players, applied to the pre-specified primary family; exploratory cells reported without inference.
design.decision_rule: An AVOID label is supported only if the pre-specified threshold is exceeded with a 95% CI lower bound above the threshold, after demeaning, survives the placebo and falsification checks, and holds in both regular season and playoffs. Otherwise report 'not established' or 'artifact'.
design.data_version: Per-game NBA stats API files for 2022-23 to 2024-25 (regular season and playoffs) and 2025-26 regular season through 2026-04-13; graph-derived possession records built from the play-by-play, with the label-validation step documented and versioned. Exclude 2025-26 playoffs for the 2026-06-19 question date.
